PLAN "Bodyweight Strength: 12 Weeks Beginner (No Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
